text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Audit Committee and City Council with the status of financial statement audits of the City’s Agencies and Corporations for the year ended December 31, 2023.

City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (June 20, 2024) from the Auditor General on the status of the financial statement audits of the City’s Agencies and Corporations for the year ended December 31, 2023 for information.
